title: Offline & Local-First Workflow
objective: Menguji seluruh fungsi inti tanpa jaringan dan menangani provider eksternal yang tidak tersedia.

acceptance.offline_open: Local project identity opens without a provider.
acceptance.offline_edit: Draft editing produces a deterministic local result.
acceptance.offline_analysis: Analysis is explicitly local and does not require a network provider.
acceptance.local_export: Export is produced from local input without external services.
acceptance.queued_optional_actions: Unavailable optional provider work is queued instead of blocking core work.
acceptance.graceful_provider_failure: Provider unavailability is represented as a recoverable result, not an uncaught failure.

evidence: Focused deterministic domain test covers all six acceptance fields and fail-closed blank identity validation. Synthetic/local evidence only; production project session wiring, native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain UNVERIFIABLE.
